data.title: Neon Gate Run
data.statement:
Midnight has fallen over Neon City. A courier must escape by crossing N security gates in a fixed order.

Each gate follows its own repeating schedule. Some gates open frequently, while others only open for a short window.

You start at global minute 0.

For each gate:

1. Travel T minutes to reach the gate.
2. The gate repeats its schedule every P minutes.
3. The gate is open for W consecutive minutes in each cycle, starting at the phase offset O.
4. If the gate is closed when you arrive, you must wait until it opens.
5. Crossing an open gate takes zero minutes.

A gate is open at global minute t exactly when:

((t - O) modulo P) < W

Modulo means the non-negative remainder, from 0 to P - 1.

All gates use the same global clock. Waiting at one gate does not reset the schedules of the other gates.

Your mission is to calculate the earliest global minute at which you have passed all N gates.

Example:

Input:
```text
4
3 5 2 0
4 6 2 1
2 7 3 5
1 4 1 3
```

Output:
```text
23
```

Explanation:

Gate 1: Arrive at minute 3, wait until minute 5.

Gate 2: Arrive at minute 9, wait until minute 13.

Gate 3: Arrive at minute 15, wait until minute 19.

Gate 4: Arrive at minute 20, wait until minute 23.

The courier escapes at minute 23.
data.constraints:
1 <= N <= 100000
0 <= T <= 1000000000
1 <= P <= 1000000000
1 <= W <= P
0 <= O < P

All values are integers.
The answer may require a 64-bit integer.
